Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game UI animation sprite sheet, one character FOUR-FRAME WALK CYCLE.
Input image1 is identity reference only, not edit target: Winter, silver blue long hair, blue eyes, dark navy dress, white fur cape, snowflake hair accessory and blue gemstone brooch. Simplify into adorable tiny 2D chibi with large head and short body, clean soft dark outlines, flat pastel cel shading, recognizable exact outfit colors. Hands tiny natural mitten silhouettes.
Output ONE SQUARE 1024x1024 PNG with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. Precisely TWO columns and TWO rows of equal 512x512 cells. NO drawn grid/borders or text. Each cell contains ONLY the SAME full-body character at the same scale, centered x256 in its local cell, foot baseline y440, top around y80, margins clear. Face three-quarter right consistently. No camera changes or size changes. Walk IN PLACE, do not move across the frame.
Four DISTINCT evenly spaced cyclic gait phases ROW-MAJOR: top-left LEFT foot forward/right back (contact); top-right legs passing, right foot lifting, arms opposite (passing); bottom-left RIGHT foot forward/left back (opposite contact); bottom-right legs passing, left foot lifting, arms opposite (passing). Small natural cape/hair sway, identical face and clothing, tiny alternating vertical body bob. Last phase naturally continues to first with no jump. FULL cycle, not four unrelated poses and not identical legs. Keep art visually simple for display at112px. No background scene, no shadow oval, no glow/clouds/particles, no words/numbers/logos/watermarks, no checkerboard pixels. Preserve transparent space between four sprites.
